comment: The runtimes benchmark/compete.py scores, pinned by version and by the SHA-256 of what is downloaded. fetch_runtimes.py fetches, verifies and unpacks them into competitors/.runtimes; a hash that does not match stops it. Every one is free and needs no key. The Python ones (smolagents, CaMeL) are pinned in requirements/competitors.txt and its lock; starlark-go is pinned by hosts/starlark/go.mod and go.sum. The table is recorded and re-derived on Linux x86_64, the platform of the CI leg.

python-wasi.comment: CPython's WASI build (wasm32-wasip1, WASI SDK 24), published by Brett Cannon, who maintains CPython's WASI support
